“蛇蜕，桐油，黄纸，蜡烛，留置针，血包，帐篷，方便面，锅......”

林舒一件一件清点着物品。

花了一个晚上的时间，他基本上已经把所有材料、装备都准备停当。

他已经下定决心，要用最快的速度把“蛇”养出来。

毕竟，这套仪轨，是自己在对抗潜在的威胁时最直接、也最有力的武器。

没有自保的能力，以后还谈什么发展？

至于乱葬岗......

说实话，林舒曾经很害怕死亡、害怕与死亡有关的一切，而他的“恐惧”，则是跟小时候的一次经历有关。

那时候，自己每次上学的时候都要经过一条小路。

那条小路穿过的是镇子边缘的一片荒地，两边都是高高的、重重叠叠的山丘。

自己一度很奇怪，为什么在已经发展起来的小镇里会留下这么一片不开发的荒地，但当然，小时候的他也没有多想。

----直到有一年清明节。

假期之后，他又回到了学校上学。

当他按照以往的习惯走进那条小路时，却发现那条小路已经完全变了。

或许是清明祭扫时的失火，又或许是有人有意为之，但总之，那条小路两侧原本茂密的树丛、荒草已经完全被焚烧殆尽。

而那些“山丘”的真实样貌，也彻底暴露了出来。

那不是什么山丘，那是堆叠、拥挤在一起的坟茔。

自己从来没见过那么拥挤的坟墓，回老家扫墓的时候，由于是在村子里，每一座坟几乎都是独占一个山头，稍微拥挤一点的，也不过是夫妻合葬、两代合葬而已。

那样的形制绝不会让人感到可怕，只会让人觉得庄严又从容。

......但那条小路不是。

小路两边的坟茔密密麻麻地挤做一堆，就好像拥挤的公交车里塞满的人。

许多坟茔的墓碑都已经破碎，更多的坟根本就没有墓碑，而只是用石头堆砌。

石头塌下来，露出后面黑黝黝的洞，从洞里伸出来的是腐朽棺木暗红色的木头茬子，还有灰扑扑的骨头。

自己夹在坟堆中间进退两难，仿佛下一秒就要被吞噬，成为那些冢中枯骨的其中一个。

那时候自己几乎是逃命一样逃出了小路，再也不敢踏进那条小路一步。

之后很长一段时间，路边的狗见到自己都狂吠不止。

自己就是在那时候留下了心理阴影的。

----但在长大之后，这种阴影也渐渐随着记忆消退。

尤其是在见到徐长顺、了解了有关“仪轨”的一切之后，仿佛一瞬间，林舒突然觉得，自己不再害怕这些未知的事物了。

坟？死亡？鬼？

鬼可能存在吧。

但谁说它不是跟“蛇”一样，是一种经由仪轨生成的、特殊的存在呢？

如果它与仪轨相关，那它就是可知的。

既然是可知的，它就不可怕......

稍稍晃了晃脑袋，林舒一件一件地把所有准备好的物品都塞进了背包。

乱葬岗就乱葬岗吧。

"Snake slough, tung oil, yellow paper, candles, indwelling needles, blood bags, tents, instant noodles, pots..."

Lin Shu counted the items one by one.

It took him one night to prepare all the materials and equipment.

He has made up his mind to raise the "snake" as quickly as possible.

After all, this ritual is the most direct and powerful weapon against potential threats.

Without the ability to protect yourself, how can we talk about development in the future?

As for the mass graves…

To be honest, Lin Shu was once very afraid of death and everything related to death, and his "fear" was related to an experience he had when he was a child.

At that time, I had to pass a small road every time I went to school.

The path passed through a wasteland on the edge of the town, with tall, overlapping hills on both sides.

He once wondered why such an undeveloped wasteland was left in a developed town, but of course, as a child, he didn't think much about it.

----Until one Qingming Festival.

After the holidays, he went back to school.

When he walked into the path as usual, he found that the path had completely changed.

Maybe it was a fire during the Qingming Festival, or maybe someone did it intentionally, but in short, the originally dense bushes and grass on both sides of the path had been completely burned.

And the true appearance of those "hills" was completely exposed.

Those are not hills, they are tombs stacked and crowded together.

I have never seen such a crowded tomb. When I went back to my hometown to sweep the tomb, because it was in a village, every tomb almost occupied a hilltop alone. The ones that were slightly more crowded were just couples buried together or two generations buried together.

Such a shape will never make people feel scary, it will only make people feel solemn and calm.

...but not that trail.

The tombs on both sides of the path were crowded together like a crowded bus filled with people.

The tombstones of many tombs are broken, and many more have no tombstones at all, but are just piled with stones.

The stone collapsed, revealing a dark hole behind it. Protruding from the hole were the dark red wood stubble of the decaying coffin, as well as the gray bones.

He was caught in a dilemma among the graves, as if he would be swallowed up in the next second and become one of the withered bones in the grave.

At that time, I almost escaped from the path as if running for my life, and I never dared to step into that path again.

For a long time after that, the dogs on the roadside kept barking when they saw me.

It was at that time that I left a psychological shadow.

----But as I grew up, this shadow gradually faded away with my memory.

Especially after meeting Xu Changshun and learning everything about the "ritual", Lin Shu suddenly felt that he was no longer afraid of these unknown things.

grave?die?ghost?

Ghosts may exist.

But who says that it is not, like a "snake", a special existence that is generated through rituals?

If it is related to sadhana, then it is knowable.

Since it is knowable, it is not scary...

With a slight shake of his head, Lin Shu stuffed all the prepared items into his backpack one by one.

Mass graves are mass graves.
